theorems.name: Submission.density_one_allard_scale
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (δ : ℝ), IsOpen U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.LocallyLp H p → ξ ∈ U → V.HasDensity ξ 1 → 0 < δ → ξ ∈ V.support ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ closedBall ξ r ⊆ U ∧ V.weight (closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) ∧ V.scaledLpNorm H p ξ r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
